name: OCaml Memory Model
description: Memory model for OCaml multicore. Based on a 'local DRF' guarantee. Provides strong guarantees for well-typed programs without data races, and well-defined (though weak) semantics for racy accesses.

catSupport.note: Defined operationally over per-location timestamped histories; the guarantees it delivers (coherence, SC atomics, local DRF) are per-execution conditions, but no cat rendering is published.
